input.quote: (g) not use the Work to act as a service bureau in whole or in part, for any other Person, except for any affiliate of Sparkling operating at the Authorized Locations.
input.rationale: Compliant: the Agreement gives Garman no audit, inspection or verification right against Sparkling. Section 3 (Restrictions on Use) runs from limb (a) to limb (g) as use covenants only, with no right for Garman to audit licence compliance, count copies, enter our sites or access our systems; Section 20 (General Matters) covers only time of the essence and notices; and searches for "audit", "inspect", "verify", "examine", "monitor", "premises", "remote" and "records" surface no audit-type right binding us. The only examination right runs in our favour (Section 16 escrow: Sparkling may itself or through independent experts examine and test the deposited materials for Garman's compliance). The sole Sparkling-side verification duty is the narrow post-termination self-certification of destruction or return in Section 17(b), which involves no Garman entry, inspection or system access and therefore does not engage this rule's frequency, notice, cost or access parameters. With no Vendor audit right in existence, we are better than the preferred position on every material term, so no redline is proposed: inserting audit parameters would manufacture a Vendor entitlement and increase our exposure. The failed "audit frequency limited" deterministic check is a heuristic false signal, as the pattern has no audit clause to match.
